content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: A2P Form in Admin Page ## slug: a2p-messaging-form ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End To support the new A2P Messaging routes we have included the required registration form directly in the signup process located in the Messaging Administration page. **NOTE:** Users must complete the [A2P submission process](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/account-activation){target=`_blank`} for both Production and Sandbox orgs. ![A2P Messaging Form included in Textey Administration Page](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/A2P%20Messaging%20Form%20included%20in%20Textey%20Administration%20Page.gif){height="" width=""}
